records.title: Speculative Decoding and Beyond: An In-Depth Review of Techniques
records.reason: Survey of generation-refinement/speculative decoding methods across autoregressive tasks, including draft strategies, verification, and deployment across compute settings. Supports a direct lineage to faster autoregressive LLM inference.

records.title: PROSERVE: Unified Multi-Priority Request Scheduling for LLM Serving
records.reason: Proposes multi-priority LLM request scheduling and associated admission/routing/offload mechanisms to improve SLO attainment and serving system gain.

records.title: EchoPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Pruning via Virtual Context Reconstruction
records.reason: Training-free KV pruning reconstructs virtual context and selects cache tokens for query-agnostic compression, reducing inference overhead while retaining task quality.

records.title: More Tokens, Lower Precision: Towards the Optimal Token-Precision Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
records.reason: Studies joint KV-cache token pruning and lower-precision storage; quantized pruning retains more tokens and improves long-context retrieval under memory constraints.

records.title: SpecBlock: Block-Iterative Speculative Decoding with Dynamic Tree Drafting
records.reason: Block-iterative speculative drafter preserves path dependence while reducing drafting cost; adaptive tree branching and verifier feedback improve LLM decoding speed.

records.title: Draft in Parallel, Condition Through Depth: Adjacent Causal Injection for Speculative Decoding
records.reason: DSpine injects predecessor-conditioned signals through network depth so parallel speculative candidates remain causally informed; reports longer accepted drafts and higher serving throughput.

records.title: DeLS-Spec: Decoupled Long-Short Contexts for Parallel Speculative Drafting
records.reason: Combines a fixed long-context speculative drafter with an independently trained local short-context head to improve acceptance and decoding speed.

records.title: Affix Cache for Diffusion Large Language Models
records.reason: ACache reuses KV states for shared spans in diffusion LLMs, recomputes selected anchor-token states, and reduces recompute latency and peak KV memory.

records.title: HeteroSpec: Leveraging Contextual Heterogeneity for Efficient Speculative Decoding
records.reason: Entropy-based candidate stratification allocates verification effort according to uncertainty and improves speculative decoding speed while preserving the target distribution.

records.title: RR-Evict: Fine-Grained Prefix Cache Eviction beyond LRU for Agentic LLM Serving
records.reason: Round-robin fine-grained agent prefix-cache eviction spreads reclamation across trajectories, reducing recomputation and tail TTFT for returning agents.

records.title: Reformulating KV Cache Eviction Problem for Long-Context LLM Inference
records.reason: LaProx evaluates cache-token contributions through output-aware layerwise approximations and inter-head interactions, retaining quality with a small KV budget.

records.title: K UN S ERVE : Parameter-centric Memory Management for Efficient Memory Throttling Handling in LLM Serving
records.reason: KunServe frees GPU memory by temporarily dropping replicated model parameters and cooperatively scheduling requests, reducing queueing and tail latency during LLM-serving overload.

records.title: A Survey of Techniques for Optimizing Transformer Inference
records.reason: Surveys algorithmic and hardware-level methods including distillation, pruning, quantization, architecture design, and accelerators to reduce Transformer inference compute and memory.

records.title: OffQ: Taming Structured Outliers in LLM Quantization by Offsetting
records.reason: Offsets structured activation outliers to enable uniform low-bit weight, activation, and KV quantization for LLM inference with lower memory and compute.

records.title: Every Bit Counts: A Theoretical Study of Precision-Expressivity Tradeoffs in Quantized Transformers
records.reason: Analyzes the precision/expressivity threshold in quantized Transformers, explaining when reduced precision changes representable functions and informing safe quantization choices.

records.title: Reinforcement Speculative Decoding for Fast Ranking
records.reason: Uses an RL-trained, budgeted up-to-down speculative procedure to accelerate LLM ranking inference and use listwise verification information across rounds.

records.title: LongSpark: Efficient speculative decoding with a fixed-cost parallel drafter
records.reason: A block-diffusion drafter extracts fixed-size views from target verification, making draft cost independent of prefix length and improving long-context speculative inference.

records.title: Efficient Attention Methods: Hardware-efficient, Sparse, Compact, and Linear Attention
records.reason: Author-hosted survey organizes hardware-efficient, sparse, compact/KV-cache, and linear attention methods and discusses computational and memory efficiency for Transformer/LLM use.

records.title: On-the-Fly Adaptive Distillation of Transformer to Dual-State Linear Attention
records.reason: DSLA-Serve adaptively replaces Transformer layers with dual-state linear attention at inference time to lower compute while preserving long-context and downstream performance.

records.title: BASE: Batch-Aware Selection of Experts Using Predicted Removal Error for Efficient MoE Decoding
records.reason: Predicts the output error from removing MoE experts and coordinates expert selection across a batch with custom inference kernels, improving serving quality-efficiency.
